ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the $1.7 billion vulnerable to fraud as per the DHS audit.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to expose potential fraudsters and identify weaknesses in the current system.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What are the common schemes used for fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal significant financial losses and potentially lead to policy changes in Medicaid management.
